fun_facts.text: Garrett is 2 wins behind Benton for #3 on the all-time wins leaderboard.
Garrett's centers outscored Benton's by 314 FP this week.
Nick's 473-point victory over Hayden was the week's most lopsided result.
Nick had the week's highest single-game score (79.75 FP from Luka Doncic) AND the lowest (-3.70 FP from Payton Pritchard).
Hayden has lost 286 games to injury this season -> 68 more than Nick's league-low 218.
Hayden has lost 26.6% of scheduled games to injury this season -> the highest burden in the league.
Nick's 61.1% career win rate leads the league by 9.3 percentage points over Hayden.
